card.name: The word Study in trial references
card.fires_on: The word Study (or study) when it names a clinical trial, especially after In or excluded from, and just before a trial number or name. Also App in Apple App Store.

modes.label: Study before trial ID
modes.description: Capitalized Study right after In, followed by a trial code or number.
